cards.card_text: And God tells Moses to put the Urim and Thummim in the breastpiece too.
cards.verse_text: And place the Urim and Thummim in the breastpiece of judgment, so that they will also be over Aaron’s heart whenever he comes before the LORD.
cards.snippet: And place the Urim and Thummim in the breastpiece of judgment, so that they will also…

cards.card_text: The Urim and Thummim go in the breastpiece.
cards.verse_text: And place the Urim and Thummim in the breastpiece of judgment, so that they will also be over Aaron’s heart whenever he comes before the LORD.
cards.snippet: And place the Urim and Thummim in the breastpiece of judgment, so that they will also…

cards.card_text: Then comes the outfit, and it is a LOT of outfit: tunic, sash, robe, ephod, woven band, then the breastpiece with the Urim and Thummim placed inside.
cards.verse_text: Then he put the breastpiece on him and placed the Urim and Thummim in the breastpiece.
cards.snippet: Then he put the breastpiece on him and placed the Urim and Thummim in the breastpiece.

cards.card_text: Eleazar will seek it by the judgment of the Urim, and at his command, Joshua and all Israel with him will go out and come in.
cards.verse_text: who will go out and come in before them, and who will lead them out and bring them in, so that the congregation of the LORD will not be like sheep without a shepherd.” He shall stand before Eleazar the priest, who will seek counsel for him before the LORD by the judgment of the Urim.
cards.snippet: …seek counsel for him before the LORD by the judgment of the Urim.

cards.card_text: Moses asks the LORD to give His Thummim and His Urim to Levi, His godly one.
cards.verse_text: Concerning Levi he said: “Give Your Thummim to Levi and Your Urim to Your godly one, whom You tested at Massah and contested at the waters of Meribah.
cards.snippet: Concerning Levi he said: “Give Your Thummim to Levi and Your Urim to Your godly one, whom You tested at Massah and contested at…

cards.card_text: Saul asks the LORD to answer with Urim if the fault is with Saul or Jonathan, and Thummim if it's with the men of Israel.
cards.verse_text: If the fault is with me or my son Jonathan, respond with Urim, but if the fault is with the men of Israel, respond with Thummim.” And Jonathan and Saul were selected, but the people were cleared of the charge.
cards.snippet: If the fault is with me or my son Jonathan, respond with Urim, but if the fault is with the men of Israel, respond with…

cards.verse_text: He inquired of the LORD, but the LORD did not answer him by dreams or Urim or prophets.
cards.snippet: …the LORD, but the LORD did not answer him by dreams or Urim or prophets.

cards.card_text: The governor tells those priestly families not to eat the most holy things until there's a priest to consult the Urim and Thummim.
cards.verse_text: The governor ordered them not to eat the most holy things until there was a priest to consult the Urim and Thummim.
cards.snippet: …the most holy things until there was a priest to consult the Urim and Thummim.

cards.card_text: Some priests search for their family records and can't find them, so they're excluded from the priesthood as unclean, and the governor tells them not to eat the most holy things until there's a priest to consult the Urim and Thummim.
cards.verse_text: The governor ordered them not to eat the most holy things until there was a priest to consult the Urim and Thummim.
